_about: Chat commands (type / in chat). scope: self = changes only your own character and runs on your machine; world = changes the shared world and runs on the host; host = only the host may use it. A client may use commands only after the host typed /op <name>. Commands are ON IN EVERY BUILD for now, release exports included (director 2026-11-10; the switch is settings `dev_commands` in core/settings_state.gd).

commands.name: help
commands.help: Lists the commands, or explains one.

commands.name: give
commands.help: Puts a rolled gun, a pony unique, an item or casino coins in your inventory. Tiers: grey green blue purple gold orange rainbow pony.

commands.name: tp
commands.help: Moves you to a place or to coordinates. In the fantasy world, place = a region or town name.

commands.name: god
commands.help: Switches taking damage off or on.

commands.name: fly
commands.help: Switches free flight off or on: you move where you look, no gravity.

commands.name: skill
commands.help: Sets a fantasy skill (woodcutting, fishing, ...) to a level.

commands.name: spells
commands.help: Lists the spells you can cast with your current channel size, or shows what a sequence such as WFA makes.

commands.name: slots
commands.help: Sets how many elements your staff can hold in one cast.

commands.name: gear
commands.help: Gives fantasy gear or materials (staffs, tools, robes, logs, fish, ore ...).

commands.name: quest
commands.help: Shows or changes the party's quest log.

commands.name: spawn
commands.help: Spawns enemies in front of you.

commands.name: trade
commands.help: Asks that player to trade guns and armour. Anyone may use it; the same as looking at them and holding the interact key.

commands.name: op
commands.help: Lets that player use commands in your session.

commands.name: deop
commands.help: Takes commands away from that player again.
